name: Global Health Ltd
about: Global Health Limited operates a network of multi-specialty tertiary and quaternary care hospitals under the Medanta brand, primarily across North and East India. The company specialises in cardiac sciences, oncology, neurosciences, digestive and hepatobiliary sciences, orthopaedics, organ transplantation, kidney and urology, and other complex medical procedures. As of June 2026, Medanta operated six hospitals across Gurugram, Lucknow, Patna, Ranchi, Indore and Noida, supported by an expanding diagnostics, pharmacy and outpatient network. [1]
keyPoints: Hospital Count Global Health operates 6 hospitals across Gurugram, Indore, Ranchi, Lucknow, Patna and Noida, with 3,737 installed beds as of June 2026 across 5.6 million sq. ft. The network has 950+ ICU beds and offers services across 30+ medical specialties. Gurugram is the flagship hospital, while Lucknow, Patna and Noida form the newer hospital portfolio where capacity and clinical services are being scaled.[1]
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 80.7% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 9.04 times its book value
